description: Department of Forest Conservation - Declare that Karathivu Forest in Ampara; Dedduwa thalan Kalapuwa Mangrove Forest in Galle; Sarasalai Mangrove Forest in Jaffna and Suduwathuraara Forest in Monaragala as Reserved Forest
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of mangrove forests as reserved forests under the Forest Conservation Ordinance, which constitutes a legal/regulatory matter. It references specific sections of ordinances and amendments, involves statutory instruments, and creates legally protected areas through government notification. While it mentions the President by name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than detailing personal portfolio responsibilities, making it a legal declaration rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
